blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has raised its wildfire prevention measures to maximum alert status amid the threat of extreme heat and dry conditions brought by a “very strong” El Niño phenomenon. In a statement on Friday, the DENR said it had begun deploying forest protection personnel, training forest officers, constructing firelines, enforcing bans on open burning and temporarily closing protected areas at high risk of wildfires. The agency warned that extreme heat and drying vegetation could create fire-prone conditions across grasslands and forests. “Our decision to deploy dedicated Bantay Gubat patrols and build firelines […]...
